name: Surge-counter earth-path interface
aliases: switchyards Switchyard earthing and lightning interfaces
summary: Identifies the documented connection of the selected surge counter within its arrester monitoring arrangement.
description: Identifies the documented connection of the selected surge counter within its arrester monitoring arrangement. Earthing and lightning interfaces identify the connections between equipment metalwork, primary protection devices and the station earthing network. Their electrical purpose differs from their physical conductor route or electrode geometry.

In a switchyard arrangement, the earthing references help connect each primary equipment structure and surge-protection device to the correct earth-grid interface. Separate details show actual joints, sizes and installation routes. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Arrester monitoring earth path” at the input and “Surge event measurement” at the output. Counter installation follows the selected equipment diagram.
